title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on the fall in Genesis 3: the serpent, the fruit and the first consequences.

questions.text: Which creature spoke to the woman in the garden?
questions.explanation: The serpent was more crafty than any animal of the field and began the conversation with a question about what God had said.

questions.text: What did the woman say God had forbidden them to do with the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden?
questions.explanation: The woman told the serpent that God had said they must not eat from it, and not touch it, or they would die.

answers.text: Pick it before it was ripe
Carry it out of the garden
Eat it or touch it, or they would die

questions.text: What did the serpent promise would happen if they ate the fruit?
questions.explanation: The serpent said their eyes would be opened and they would be like God, knowing good and evil.

answers.text: Their eyes would be opened and they would be like God
They would live in the garden forever
They would be able to fly

questions.text: What did the man and woman do after they ate the fruit?
questions.explanation: Their eyes were opened, they knew that they were naked, and they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings.

answers.text: They left the garden at once
They sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves

questions.text: Where did the man and woman hide when they heard God walking in the garden?
questions.explanation: They hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

answers.text: Among the trees of the garden

questions.text: Whom did the man blame first when God asked him about the fruit?
questions.explanation: The man said that the woman whom God gave to be with him gave him fruit from the tree, and he ate.

answers.text: The woman God had given him

questions.text: What did God say would happen to the serpent?
questions.explanation: God cursed the serpent above all livestock and every animal of the field: on its belly it would go, and dust it would eat.

answers.text: It would be cast into the sea
It would be turned to stone
It would crawl on its belly and eat dust

questions.text: What name did the man give his wife?
questions.explanation: The man called his wife Eve, because she would be the mother of all the living.

questions.text: What did God make for Adam and his wife to wear?
questions.explanation: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife and clothed them.

questions.text: What did God place at the east of the garden to guard the way to the tree of life?
questions.explanation: God placed cherubim and the flame of a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
